Hey robot crew, quick one from facilities. Alpha (alpha), you’re starting at the charging pod (charge_pod). Beta (beta), you’re in the archive room (archive_room). We need the heavy oak bookcase (oak_bookcase_heavy) moved from the front desk (front_desk) to the charging pod. Watch out: the corridor between the archive room and the front desk could have debris. If a robot is at the archive room, clear it with ClearPath before trying to pass. For routing: the archive room connects to the charging pod and the front desk. The charging pod connects back to the archive room and to the restoration lab (restoration_lab). The front desk connects back to the archive room and to the restoration lab. The reading hall (reading_hall) connects to the restoration lab, and the restoration lab connects to the charging pod, front desk, reading hall, and book return bin (return_bin). The book return bin connects back to the restoration lab. You can dock at the charging pod after placing the bookcase there.
